```{r startup, include = F}
## Set chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  cache.extra = tools::md5sum(here::here("Data", "Clean Data.rds")) # Some chunks cache objects; reset them if Clean Data.rds changes
)

## Set seed
set.seed(57135)


## Load packages
library(here)
library(mirt)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
`%+%` <- paste0

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = T)


## Load data
df <- readRDS(here("Data", "Clean Data.rds"))

# Sensitivity sample: all HMS, NHANES 2021-2023 only
# All three schemes are refit on the pooled (main) data and on these data, for direct comparison
# Prevalence is not repeated here: Analysis.Rmd already uses NHANES 2021-2023 for prevalence
df_recent <- df %>%
  filter(most_recent_survey)


## Set global variables
phq_items <- "phq_" %+% 1:9

groups <- c("HMS", "NHANES")

item_labels <- c(
  phq_1 = "1. Anhedonia",
  phq_2 = "2. Depressed mood",
  phq_3 = "3. Sleep",
  phq_4 = "4. Fatigue",
  phq_5 = "5. Appetite",
  phq_6 = "6. Feeling bad about self",
  phq_7 = "7. Concentration",
  phq_8 = "8. Psychomotor",
  phq_9 = "9. Suicidal ideation"
)

# Item labels for tables (no period after the number, which pandoc would turn into a list)
item_labels_table <- set_names(str_remove(item_labels, "\\."), names(item_labels))
 
response_labels <- c(
  "0" = "Not at all",
  "1" = "Several days",
  "2" = "More than half the days",
  "3" = "Nearly every day"
)


## Set visual style
sample_colors <- c("NHANES" = "#0072B2", "HMS" = "#D55E00")

response_colors <- c("#a9c9ef", "#5d9ae3", "#2a78d6", "#0b3f80") # Light to dark blue: "not at all" to "nearly every day"


## Set scheme labels (used in all cross-scheme tables and figures)
scheme_labels <- c(
  inv = "No Anchors (All Other Items Constrained)",
  emp = "Empirical Anchors (4, 5)",
  the = "Theory-Driven Anchors (1, 2)"
)

scheme_colors <- set_names(c("#1B2430", "#1baf7a", "#6250d6"), scheme_labels)


## Set data labels (main analysis vs. sensitivity analysis)
data_labels <- c(
  pooled = "NHANES 2011-23 (main analysis)",
  recent = "NHANES 2021-23 only"
)

data_colors <- set_names(c("#A6A6A6", "#0072B2"), data_labels)
 
theme_style <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0),
      panel.spacing = unit(10, "pt")
    )
}


## Set helper functions
# Format a data frame as an HTML table (missing values print as blank)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

format_table <- function(x, caption, digits = 2, ...) {
  x %>%
    kable(caption = caption, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"),
      full_width = F,
      position = "left"
    )
}

# Format p-values for tables
format_p <- function(p) if_else(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p))

# DIF tests (uniform, non-uniform, omnibus) side by side; each test a data frame with item, X2, df, p
dif_test_table <- function(tests, caption) {
  tests %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "test") %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    mutate(anchor = any(df == 0)) %>% # Anchor items are not tested
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(X2, df), ~ if_else(anchor, NA_real_, .x)),
      p = if_else(anchor, NA_character_, format_p(p)),
      item = item_labels_table[item],
      test = factor(test, levels = names(tests))
    ) %>%
    select(-anchor) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = test, values_from = c(X2, df, p), names_glue = "{test}_{.value}") %>%
    select(item, all_of(as.vector(t(outer(names(tests), c("X2", "df", "p"), paste, sep = "_"))))) %>%
    format_table(caption, digits = 1, col.names = c("Item", rep(c("χ²", "df", "p"), 3))) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, set_names(rep(3, 3), names(tests))))
}

# Meade (2010) item-level effect sizes
effect_size_table <- function(effect_sizes, caption) {
  effect_sizes %>%
    transmute(
      Item = item_labels_table[item],
      SIDS, UIDS, ESSD,
      `Max difference` = max.D,
      `Theta at max` = theta.of.max.D
    ) %>%
    format_table(caption)
}

save_figure <- function(plot, name, height, width = 7) {
  ggsave(
    filename = here("Figure - " %+% name %+% ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

# Sample

```{r sample}
list(pooled = df, recent = df_recent) %>%
  map(~ count(.x, sample_fct)) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = data, values_from = n) %>%
  format_table("Analytic sample sizes", col.names = c("Sample", data_labels))
```

# Functions

```{r functions}
## Fit a two-group graded response model with the given items held equal across groups
fit_model <- function(data, invariant_items) {
  multipleGroup(
    data = data[, phq_items],
    model = 1,
    group = data$sample_fct,
    itemtype = "graded",
    invariance = c(invariant_items, "free_means", "free_var"),
    verbose = F
  )
}


## Expected item scores on a theta grid by item and group; models[[j]] is the model used for item j
expected_scores <- function(models) {
  theta_grid <- seq(-5, 5, .01)

  expand_grid(item = 1:9, group = groups) %>%
    pmap(function(item, group) {
      item_parameters <- extract.item(extract.group(models[[item]], group), item)

      tibble(
        theta = theta_grid,
        item = item,
        group = group,
        ev = expected.item(item_parameters, theta_grid)
      )
    }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}


## Test-level DIF: HMS minus NHANES expected total score, averaged over HMS respondents' EAP thetas
test_level_impact <- function(model, curves) {
  theta_hat_hms <- fscores(extract.group(model, "HMS"), method = "EAP")[, 1]

  tcc_gap <- curves %>%
    group_by(theta, group) %>%
    summarize(total = sum(ev), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = total) %>%
    mutate(
      theta = round(theta, 2),
      gap = HMS - NHANES
    )

  tibble(theta = round(theta_hat_hms, 2)) %>%
    left_join(tcc_gap, by = "theta") %>%
    summarize(
      STDS = mean(gap),
      UTDS = mean(abs(gap))
    )
}


## Fit all three schemes; return effect sizes, curves, latent means and impact
run_schemes <- function(data) {

  # Models: all items equal; empirical anchors; theory-driven anchors
  models <- list(
    inv = fit_model(data, phq_items),
    emp = fit_model(data, c("phq_4", "phq_5")),
    the = fit_model(data, c("phq_1", "phq_2"))
  )

  # Main scheme: release each item in turn
  released_models <- map(1:9, ~ fit_model(data, phq_items[-.x]))

  # Item-level effect sizes (Meade, 2010)
  effect_sizes <- list(
    inv = map2(released_models, 1:9, ~ empirical_ES(.x, focal_items = .y) %>% rownames_to_column("item")) %>%
      bind_rows(),
    emp = empirical_ES(models$emp, focal_items = 1:9) %>% rownames_to_column("item"),
    the = empirical_ES(models$the, focal_items = 1:9) %>% rownames_to_column("item")
  )

  # Expected item scores
  curves <- list(
    inv = expected_scores(released_models),
    emp = expected_scores(rep(list(models$emp), 9)),
    the = expected_scores(rep(list(models$the), 9))
  )

  # HMS latent mean and SD
  latent_means <- models %>%
    map(~ coef(.x, simplify = T)$HMS) %>%
    map(~ tibble(mean = .x$means[1], sd = sqrt(.x$cov[1, 1]))) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "scheme")

  # Test-level impact
  impact <- map2(models, curves, test_level_impact) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "scheme")

  # Individual-level impact: DIF-adjusted vs naive theta
  theta_naive <- fscores(models$inv, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = T)
  salient_threshold <- median(theta_naive[, "SE_F1"])

  individual_impact <- models[c("emp", "the")] %>%
    map(~ tibble(
      sample = data$sample_fct,
      theta_naive = theta_naive[, "F1"],
      theta_adjusted = fscores(.x, method = "EAP")[, "F1"]
    )) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "scheme") %>%
    mutate(diff = theta_adjusted - theta_naive) %>%
    group_by(scheme, sample) %>%
    summarize(
      r = cor(theta_naive, theta_adjusted),
      mean_diff = mean(diff),
      sd_diff = sd(diff),
      max_abs_diff = max(abs(diff)),
      pct_salient = mean(abs(diff) > salient_threshold),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    models = models,
    effect_sizes = bind_rows(effect_sizes, .id = "scheme"),
    curves = bind_rows(curves, .id = "scheme"),
    latent_means = latent_means,
    impact = impact,
    individual_impact = individual_impact,
    salient_threshold = salient_threshold
  )
}
```

# Fit Models

```{r fit-models, cache = T}
results <- list(pooled = df, recent = df_recent) %>%
  map(run_schemes)

# Keep only the 2021-2023 models (for DIF tests below); pooled models are in Analysis.Rmd
results$pooled$models <- NULL
```

# DIF Tests, NHANES 2021-2023

```{r dif-tests, cache = T}
models_recent <- results$recent$models

## No anchors: free each item in turn from the all-equal model
uniform_test_inv <- DIF(models_recent$inv, which.par = c("d1", "d2", "d3"), scheme = "drop", p.adjust = "none")
omnibus_test_inv <- DIF(models_recent$inv, which.par = c("a1", "d1", "d2", "d3"), scheme = "drop", p.adjust = "none")

## Anchored schemes: constrain each non-anchor item in turn in the free-baseline model
nonuniform_test_emp <- DIF(models_recent$emp, which.par = "a1", scheme = "add", p.adjust = "none")
omnibus_test_emp <- DIF(models_recent$emp, which.par = c("a1", "d1", "d2", "d3"), scheme = "add", p.adjust = "none")

nonuniform_test_the <- DIF(models_recent$the, which.par = "a1", scheme = "add", p.adjust = "none")
omnibus_test_the <- DIF(models_recent$the, which.par = c("a1", "d1", "d2", "d3"), scheme = "add", p.adjust = "none")
```

```{r dif-test-tables}
## Tidy one DIF() result
tidy_dif <- function(test) {
  test %>%
    rownames_to_column("item") %>%
    select(item, X2, df, p)
}

## Difference between two nested tests (omnibus minus the other)
difference_test <- function(omnibus, other, df) {
  tibble(
    item = rownames(omnibus),
    X2 = omnibus$X2 - other$X2,
    df = df,
    p = pchisq(X2, df = df, lower.tail = F)
  )
}

dif_test_table(
  list(
    Uniform = tidy_dif(uniform_test_inv),
    `Non-uniform` = difference_test(omnibus_test_inv, uniform_test_inv, df = 1),
    Omnibus = tidy_dif(omnibus_test_inv)
  ),
  "DIF tests, NHANES 2021-23: " %+% scheme_labels[["inv"]]
)

dif_test_table(
  list(
    Uniform = difference_test(omnibus_test_emp, nonuniform_test_emp, df = 3),
    `Non-uniform` = tidy_dif(nonuniform_test_emp),
    Omnibus = tidy_dif(omnibus_test_emp)
  ),
  "DIF tests, NHANES 2021-23: " %+% scheme_labels[["emp"]] %+% " (anchor items show no test)"
)

dif_test_table(
  list(
    Uniform = difference_test(omnibus_test_the, nonuniform_test_the, df = 3),
    `Non-uniform` = tidy_dif(nonuniform_test_the),
    Omnibus = tidy_dif(omnibus_test_the)
  ),
  "DIF tests, NHANES 2021-23: " %+% scheme_labels[["the"]] %+% " (anchor items show no test)"
)
```

# Comparison: Main vs. 2021-2023

## Item-Level DIF

```{r compare-items}
## Effect sizes by data set and scheme
effect_sizes <- results %>%
  map("effect_sizes") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  mutate(
    anchor = case_when(
      scheme == "emp" ~ item %in% c("phq_4", "phq_5"),
      scheme == "the" ~ item %in% c("phq_1", "phq_2"),
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    data = factor(data_labels[data], levels = data_labels),
    scheme = factor(scheme_labels[scheme], levels = scheme_labels)
  )

results %>%
  map("effect_sizes") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  select(data, scheme, item, SIDS) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = data, values_from = SIDS) %>%
  mutate(
    change = recent - pooled,
    scheme = scheme_labels[scheme],
    item = item_labels_table[item]
  ) %>%
  format_table(
    "SIDS by scheme: main analysis vs. NHANES 2021-23 only",
    col.names = c("Scheme", "Item", data_labels, "Change")
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")


## Plot: SIDS, main vs. 2021-23, by scheme
sids_comparison_plot <- effect_sizes %>%
  mutate(item = factor(item_labels[item], levels = rev(item_labels))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(SIDS, item)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_line(aes(group = item), color = "grey80", linewidth = .6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = data, shape = anchor), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ scheme, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = data_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 1),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Studied item", `TRUE` = "Anchor item")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "SIDS: HMS minus NHANES expected item score at the same theta (points, 0-3)") +
  scale_y_discrete(name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Item-Level DIF (SIDS): Main Analysis vs. NHANES 2021-23 Only") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), panel.spacing.x = unit(14, "pt"))

sids_comparison_plot

save_figure(sids_comparison_plot, "Sensitivity - SIDS, Main vs 2021-23", height = 4.5, width = 8)
```

## Latent Means and Test-Level Impact

```{r compare-test-level}
## HMS latent mean and SD
results %>%
  map("latent_means") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = data, values_from = c(mean, sd), names_glue = "{data}_{.value}") %>%
  transmute(
    scheme = scheme_labels[scheme],
    pooled_mean, pooled_sd, recent_mean, recent_sd
  ) %>%
  format_table(
    "HMS latent mean and SD (NHANES fixed at mean 0, SD 1)",
    col.names = c("Scheme", "Mean", "SD", "Mean", "SD")
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, set_names(c(2, 2), data_labels)))


## Test-level DIF (STDS, UTDS)
results %>%
  map("impact") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = data, values_from = c(STDS, UTDS), names_glue = "{data}_{.value}") %>%
  transmute(
    scheme = scheme_labels[scheme],
    pooled_STDS, pooled_UTDS, recent_STDS, recent_UTDS
  ) %>%
  format_table(
    "Test-level DIF: HMS minus NHANES expected total score, averaged over HMS respondents",
    col.names = c("Scheme", "STDS", "UTDS", "STDS", "UTDS")
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, set_names(c(2, 2), data_labels)))


## Individual-level impact
results %>%
  map("individual_impact") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  mutate(
    data = data_labels[data],
    scheme = scheme_labels[scheme],
    pct_salient = percent(pct_salient, .1)
  ) %>%
  select(data, scheme, everything()) %>%
  format_table(
    "Individual-level DIF impact: DIF-adjusted minus naive theta (salient if |difference| > median SE: " %+%
      sprintf("%.2f", results$pooled$salient_threshold) %+% " main, " %+%
      sprintf("%.2f", results$recent$salient_threshold) %+% " 2021-23)",
    digits = 3,
    col.names = c("Data", "Scheme", "Sample", "r", "Mean difference", "SD of difference", "Max |difference|", "% salient")
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "top")


## Plot: test characteristic curves, main vs. 2021-23
tcc_comparison <- results %>%
  map("curves") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "data") %>%
  filter(between(theta, -3, 4)) %>%
  group_by(data, scheme, theta, group) %>%
  summarize(total = sum(ev), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    data = factor(data_labels[data], levels = data_labels),
    scheme = factor(scheme_labels[scheme], levels = scheme_labels),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NHANES", "HMS"))
  )

tcc_comparison_plot <- tcc_comparison %>%
  ggplot(aes(theta, total, color = group, linetype = data)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, color = "grey70", linewidth = .3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  facet_wrap(~ scheme, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = set_names(c("dotted", "solid"), data_labels)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression("Depression (" * theta * ", NHANES SD units)"),
    limits = c(-3, 4),
    breaks = -3:4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Expected PHQ-9 total score",
    limits = c(0, 27),
    breaks = seq(0, 27, 3)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Expected PHQ-9 Total Score by θ, Group, and Anchoring Scheme: Main Analysis vs. NHANES 2021-23 Only") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), panel.spacing.x = unit(14, "pt"))

tcc_comparison_plot

save_figure(tcc_comparison_plot, "Sensitivity - Test Characteristic Curves, Main vs 2021-23", height = 3.6, width = 8)
```
